generated_for: Ben Kelly Surfboards official named standup catalog
source: https://www.benkellysurfboards.com/surfboards (Squarespace model pages — excludes custom deposits, merch, and build-your-own custom shape)

brands.name: Ben Kelly Surfboards
brands.short_description: Handcrafted performance and custom surfboards by Ben Kelly in Santa Cruz — shortboards, grovelers, fish, hybrids, and longboards shaped locally with Paradise Fiberglass.

models.name: GROM beta
models.description: Developed with Cole Renfrew, the GROM beta is a grom-sized version of The Beta performance shortboard model — super versatile for performance surfing in the pocket and above the lip. Type: High Performance Shortboard. Sizes: 4'8–5'4. Best for: 2–6ft punchy beach break / reef / points.

models.name: The beta
models.description: Developed with team rider Luke Bender, The Beta is the most performance oriented model in the BKS quiver — ultra responsive and rips in the pocket when waves are pumping. Type: High Performance Shortboard. Sizes: 5'6–6'10. Best for: 4–10ft+ punchy beach break / reef.

models.name: Dream Sled
models.description: A blend between the high performance Beta and the grovely Weasel — an even keeled all-around shortboard that handles punchy beach break and longer drawn out point sections. Type: Performance Shortboard. Sizes: 5'6–6'10. Best for: 2–7ft beach / reef / point.

models.name: The Weasel
models.description: Developed in Santa Cruz with Kyle Pitchford — an all-around grovely shortboard that sneaks you into waves without sacrificing high performance feel. Fast, loose, and it grovels. Type: Performance Groveler. Sizes: 5'1–6'5. Best for: 2–6ft everything.

models.name: Signature Series
models.description: The most versatile board in the BKS quiver — a retro styled shortboard that brings flow, speed, and response into one balanced shape for travel or when you are not sure what to ride. Type: Retro Groveler. Sizes: 5'0–7'0. Best for: everything — one board quiver.

models.name: Pool Party
models.description: Skatey and loose — a squashed down stubby potato chip loaded for fun when the waves tend smaller. Type: Mini Groveler / Summer Board. Sizes: 5'0–6'2. Best for: 1–4ft+ wonky beach break or fun point break.

models.name: Classic Fish
models.description: A retro Classic Fish with wide swallow tail, lots of volume, and a convex tail out the swallow for responsive rail-to-rail performance unlike typical fish shapes. Type: Fish / Retro. Sizes: 5'0–6'6. Best for: 2–6ft+ points, reefs, and mellow rollers.

models.name: The Tiny Dancer
models.description: Inspired by Robbie Sweetman and Nick Buller — an alternative hybrid that paddles like a longboard yet maneuvers like a fish. Ideal for transitioning from longboard to shortboard or as a cruiser without hauling a full log. Type: Hybrid. Sizes: 6'6–7'9. Best for: 1–6ft+ points, reefs, and rollers.

models.name: California Cruzer
models.description: Made to cruise Pleasure Point — paddles like a dream with stability and maneuverability in one beautiful longboard. Type: Longboard. Sizes: 8'6–10'0. Best for: 2–6ft point break and rollers.

models.name: Steamboat
models.description: Designed for supreme stability and noseriding — an old-school classic with wide hips and a fat square tail for trimming and nose-riding in gutless rollers. Type: Longboard. Sizes: 9'0–10'6. Best for: 0–4ft ripples, dribblers, and gutless rollers.
